name: Iwahara Junta
source:
Leader of the street gang [url=/c700]Ayame[/url] joined. A violently savage man with little respect for women and even less regard for anyone opposing his wishes. Junta maintains several Yakuza contacts, trafficking narcotics and illegal merchandise for the criminal syndicate. Though lacking redeemable humane traits, he is proficient at immoral profiteering and gang warfare.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120320235028/http://www.erogereview.com/2011/06/07/gokuin-no-sentou//]Nargrakhan's review[/url].]
